prospect.name: Mandeep Daby
prospect.family_status: Not married, no children; has a partner and plans to propose in the next two to three years; has brothers
prospect.training_background: Trains at home; kettlebell workouts roughly three times a week after finding Trevor's Instagram channel; daily yoga; boxing at times. Was around 10% body fat in 2024 working with a dietitian.
prospect.medical: Intermittent lower back aches attributed to dentistry work; says daily yoga improves it. Dietary restrictions (no beef, pork or squid). No other conditions disclosed.

signals: Was 10% body fat in 2024 and is now self-reported 24%; explicitly wants that former state back
Attributes the loss of ground to a hard work season — 'I've been so swamped with work, so I didn't really get the chance'
Also carries optimizer signals (trains daily, confident, business owner), but price was a hard barrier which is atypical for the optimizer

goals.text: Get back to roughly 10% body fat from a self-reported 24%
Gain five to ten pounds of muscle and look 'jacked' with a six pack
Recover the energy he had at 10% body fat and stop feeling sluggish after lunch, including at work
Have a structured, trackable system he can actually stay on rather than ad hoc workouts
Keep moving well and age well — maintain mobility and function as he gets older
Look good for his wedding day and for the partner he plans to propose to
Show his brothers the programme works so they join too
Train functionally rather than 'mechanical' gym bodybuilding that does not carry into real life

pains.text: Self-describes as 'skinny fat' at 24% body fat after being at 10% two years ago; fat stored around the stomach
Sluggish in the afternoons after lunch; rates his low-energy level a six or seven out of ten
Has kettlebells and trains, but has no structure, programme or way to track progress
Fell off training and diet for several months when work got busy; calls it a mental/priority problem rather than a real impossibility
Eats out frequently — fried noodles, fried rice, biryani — heavy on oil and salt, and protein is around 100g which he concedes is low
Lower back aches from the postures of dentistry, currently managed with daily yoga
Tends to slip back into old habits without someone holding him to it

objections.raw_quote: It's manageable, but I need some time to arrange.
objections.rep_response: Isolated the objection ('sounds like if you would have the money at the moment, you would just want to do it'), confirmed it was a lump-sum problem, then opened a live payment-plan negotiation.

objections.raw_quote: Oh, like, see, if I do it now, it will cripple the clinic financially.
objections.rep_response: Kept walking the number down — 12 instalments refused, six at $1,200 refused, then a $500 deposit, then 'it can be 50' — and asked whether he had a rainy-day fund he could touch.

objections.raw_quote: Give me, like, annals a week and what we can do. How about that?
objections.rep_response: Refused twice ('The reason I'm saying no to that is I know that you're committed to yourself') and pressed for any card payment to lock commitment, then eventually conceded to a Thursday check-in.

offer.payment_plan_terms: Rep quoted six monthly payments of $1,200 (a $7,200 total) and described the split as costing '200 a month' extra; said in-house maximum is five, sometimes six payments; said third-party financing exists but only accepts US credit scores; said the minimum to start coaching is one $1,200 payment; then improvised a $500 deposit to hold the place, and when the card declined asked for $200, then $100, then 'it can be 50'.

evidence: Prospect verbally agreed to the plan in principle — 'I'm already sold on the plan. For me, it's just like a thing of making it possible now'
Counter-evidence: the $500 deposit was declined on the card — 'it's saying like I don't have enough credit on that'
No payment collected, no Trevor onboarding call booked, no agreement signed
Call ended on a check-in arrangement: 'I will check in with you on Friday, but I expect a message on Thursday from you'
outcome.next_step: Prospect to move cash from his clinic/company account into his personal account and message Richard by Thursday; Richard to check in Friday; a $500 deposit then $700 to reach the $1,200 minimum needed to start coaching.

notable.note: The whole back third of the call is an improvised payment-plan negotiation that produced a plan totalling $7,200 rather than $6,000, an invented $500 deposit, and — after the card declined — repeated requests for progressively smaller amounts from a prospect who had just said paying now would 'cripple the clinic financially'. He is a strong-fit prospect on profile who could not clear a $500 charge.

quality.notes: Frequent inversions throughout — long stretches of rep questioning appear under the Mandeep Daby label (e.g. 00:01:54, 00:04:46, 00:30:19, 00:53:59) and prospect answers appear under the Richard Claessen label. Role was read from content throughout.
